title: Tower Tumble
description: Pull blocks from a leaning tower and stack them on top — one wrong tug and it all comes down. Play free solo or take turns with your party.
author: Isaac
controls: Drag a block to pull it free, then drag it over the tower and release to drop it on top. Right-drag rotates the camera, scroll zooms. On touch: one finger drags blocks, two fingers orbit and zoom.
